<infobox theme="Family">
	<image source="image"></image>

        <data source="type"><label>Family type</label></data>	
        <data source="species"><label>Species</label></data>	
        <data source="first"><label>First member(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="head"><label>Family head(s)</label></data>
        <data source="relatives"><label>Relatives</label></data>		
        <data source="origin"><label>Place(s) of origin</label></data>
        <data source="locations"><label>Other locations</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological and political information</header>
        <data source="early"><label>Earliest appearance</label></data>
        <data source="prominence"><label>Prominence</label></data>	
        <data source="fragmented"><label>Fragmented</label></data>	      
        <data source="restored"><label>Restored</label></data>	
        <data source="extinct"><label>Extinction of family name</label></data>  
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Family|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
